demo.problem: High-intent shoppers abandon a checkout that asks for more steps than they need.
demo.goal: Test a one-item Buy Now path with a controlled audience and a clear conversion metric.
demo.payoff: The team learns whether speed lifts conversion before replacing the standard journey.

pull_request.title: feat: add express checkout — Buy Now bypasses cart
pull_request.body: Adds a Buy Now button on every product card that routes to /express-checkout, a streamlined single-item checkout form (name, email, card only — no address). Adds /api/express-checkout route that tracks both checkout-completed and express-checkout-conversion events.
